title.narrative: Project to support malaria control in Congo - Congo (01-May-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Congo, Malaria, Catholic Relief Services - United States Conference of Catholic Bishops (CRS HQ)This program has the following goals: By 2020, have contributed to a 20% reduction in morbidity and mortality compared to 2016. The objectives of this program are: By 2020, at least 80% of the general population sleeps under LLINs. By 2020, at least 80% of pregnant women are sleeping under LLINs. By 2020, at least 80% of children 5 and under are sleeping under LLINs. At least 90% of households own a LLIN for 2 people
